_comment: Teaching Seccomp profile: default-allow (blacklist style, like the AppArmor demo) that denies memfd_create, the syscall behind in-memory/fileless execution. NOTE: we do NOT block execve here -- the container runtime needs it to launch the entrypoint, so blocking it stops the container from ever starting. In production you use default-deny (allowlist), like Docker's built-in default profile.

syscalls.comment: deny the fileless primitive: an anonymous in-RAM file to exec from
